statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry with vendorProject Progress Software carrying a dateAdded value between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one vulnerability record whose vendorProject field is Progress Software and whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV record carries vendorProject Progress Software with a dateAdded inside that window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: LexisNexis Risk Solutions reports a data breach affecting 100000 or more individuals to the Maine Attorney General between 2026-08-11 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Maine AG data breach notification database lists a filing by LexisNexis Risk Solutions or a LexisNexis entity, dated 2026-08-11 through 2026-12-31, with total affected of 100000 or more.
failure_condition: No such filing appears, or every LexisNexis filing in the window reports fewer than 100000 affected individuals.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: NYMEX front-month WTI crude settles at or below 72.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-11 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if CME official settlement data for the front-month NYMEX WTI light sweet crude contract shows a settlement price of 72.00 or lower on any trading day from 2026-08-11 through 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI settlement in that window prints above 72.00 dollars per barrel.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

resolution: TRUE if CME official settlement data for the front-month NYMEX WTI light sweet crude contract shows a settlement price of 100.00 or higher on any trading day from 2026-08-11 through 2026-10-30.

statement: Iranian forces seize or forcibly board at least one commercial merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if UKMTO issues an incident advisory describing an Iranian seizure or boarding of a merchant vessel in that area within the window and at least one of Reuters, AP, or AFP reports the same incident.
failure_condition: No Iranian seizure or forcible boarding of a merchant vessel occurs in that area during the window.
